title: MindAttic Universe Interchange
description: Prose-agnostic universe file: one universe, many typed entities with relations. Designed to be imported into Prose as a Universe and consumed by games/tools via CLI or MCP.

source.description: Optional provenance of this file (RFC 0017, PRS-T916): who generated it and from what. Kept with the universe and returned on export.

type.description: Open set; core types below. 'prose-text' is reserved for Prose's own texts (docs/CONDUIT.md) and is refused on import.

to.description: Entity id (dangling allowed; marks future work)

guid.description: Export only (PRS-T923): the entity's Prose database id, stable for its life. Ignored on import.

origin.description: Export only (PRS-T923): 'import' for an entity an interchange import brought in (the consumer's), 'prose' for one Prose authored itself (never retired by a replace import; set aside by the consumer kit's round-trip check). Ignored on import.
